summary: Rewrote list_all for the current Tidewater contract: /v2 paths, limit (default and cap 200) sent on every request, cursor/has_more pagination with filters on the first request only, stop at has_more false, and 429/503 retries (4 attempts, Retry-After as seconds or HTTP date via now(), defaults 1s/2s, waits via sleep). Updated tests; python -m unittest passes.
